✖️The Manila Trench Megarisk is the single greatest point of failure for our global society.🌏

2 weeks ago I wrote about the ability of small disasters to leverage catastrophic economic consequences. 

Today, I have identified the most devastating disaster the world would ever reasonably face - and the simulation results are shocking 🌊

>50-200 day breakdowns at critical ports = semiconductors & cheap consumer goods collapse

>disruption to the Straits of Malacca + South China sea = oil to East Asia is halved & global commodity pricing limbo

>20 million refugees = huge HADR and geopolitical exploitation in South China sea and beyond

>deep-sea cables cut = internet blackouts and continental disconnection

>shattering the Golden Triangle of tech = ending Asia's influence in global export

These are only a snippet of what happens when a 9.0 thrust event hits.

Here's the science 🌊

The Philippines sits at the intersection of three tectonic plates (the Philippine Sea Plate, the Eurasian Plate, and the Sunda Plate) and atop the Pacific Ring of Fire.

The Manila trench, located west of Luzon, is a subduction zone where the Eurasian Plate is sliding under the Philippines. It has been seismically quiet for centuries, meaning it is currently 'locked' and accumulating massive strain.

A rupture would trigger a 'mega-tsunami' with waves exceeding 10 meters (33 feet) and would affect the entire Asia-Pacific - changing the seafloor, flooding coasts, and creating long-term wetlands in dry areas.

Further break down of the 4 major risks 🌊

Because the Manila trench sits at the nexus of the 'Silicon Inputs' (Taiwan), Asia's 'Factory Delta' (Pearl River Delta), Asia's 'Gas Intersection' (Straits of Malacca + South China Seas), and Asia's 'Undersea Cable Crossroads,' the GDP and strategic losses would be structural rather than just cyclical.

>Silicon Inputs:

Kaohsiung/Tainan is home to critical advanced semiconductor nodes. 

Even if 'clean rooms' remain watertight, the vibration from a 9.0 earthquake event would misalign lithography machines worth $200M each = a 6-month freeze in advanced chip supply --> a $2.5 Trillion drag on global GDP as automotive, AI, and consumer electronics industries.

>Asia's Factory Delta

The Pearl River Delta (GBA) accounts for nearly 10% of China’s total GDP. 

A 3-meter surge in the flat delta region from this tsunami would push salt water miles inland & seawater destroys heavy machinery and electrical grids permanently.

Recent simulations suggest that a Manila Trench event would close the ports of Hong Kong and Shenzhen for up to 200 days, extinguishing $3.4 Billion in trade value per day from the global system.

>Asia's Gas Intersection

A global supply chain fracture would develop as a result of this megathrust. A Manila Trench tsunami would shut down the Straits of Malacca and much of the South China sea = the price of oil and LNG will diverge wildly between the Atlantic and Pacific.

It is the most vital energy artery on the planet.

The Straits are shallow and sudden shifts in the seabed and massive sediment displacement would render existing nautical charts obsolete. But VLCCs cannot navigate without precise depth data. A single grounded tanker would block the entire world's energy supply for weeks.

The Straits alone pass roughly 1/3 of all global seaborne oil trade.

Japan & South Korea get nearly 90% of their petroleum and 60% of their LNG from this corridor. Without this flow, their economies have approximately 90 days of strategic reserves before a total industrial halt = mega inflation (especially for the JPY).

Roughly 60% to 70% of China's oil imports come through this 'gas intersection.' The country's economy can be strangled at this single chokepoint.

And the geopolitical angle makes it even crazier.

The South China sea is littered with oil and gas platforms (specifically off the coasts of Vietnam, Malaysia, and Brunei).

Tsunami waves traveling through deep water have immense kinetic energy. They would sheer the legs of older platforms and snap undersea pipelines = a massive, multi-national environmental disaster that would require 'Disaster Sovereignty' to manage --> giving China a pretext to 'police' the entire sea for environmental reasons.

China could use it's vast SPR as a diplomatic carrot for ASEAN (while hedging local demand via Russian pipelines) --> offering oil to Philippines/Vietnam in exchange for dropping South China sea claims.

Likewise, other powers with high reserves (like the US) will have immense leverage over energy-starved nations.

Satellite internet and massive carrier-lead naval fleets become critical to maintaining civilization in these areas. Two areas the US dominate in.

To sum up the most probable geopolitical 🌏 outcomes:

>Oil prices likely spike to $200+ per barrel within 48 hours.

>Japan, South Korea (and the greater ASEAN) may be forced to negotiate directly with Beijing for energy security if the US cannot provide an immediate energy bridge.

>Physical changes to the South China Sea floor will be used by all parties to re-interpret maritime borders and Exclusive Economic Zones.

>US strategic communications advantage (space-based internet/comms) + energy dominance + refugee support (through Carrier Groups) = huge push for US to contest China.

More on these second order geopolitical outcomes in another thread.

>Undersea Cable Crossroads

The Manila Trench is a graveyard for undersea fiber-optic cables. A megathrust event would likely trigger submarine landslides, severing the cables that link the US to Singapore and Southeast Asia, forcing all regional data onto high-latency satellite backups.

The effects on economies, cultures, and political relationships could be profound.

This topic is too vast for one tweet, so expect more on this in future updates.

To sum up the economic risk 👇

Estimated Global Economic Costs:

Total Regional Direct Loss: ~$500 Billion+

Global Supply Chain Multiplier: ~$3 Trillion+ (24mos)

A Manila trench 9.0 megathrust would likely lead to the insolvency of several regional re-insurers, triggering a secondary liquidity crisis in Asian markets.

Net assessment:

A Manila trench disaster would act as the most influential environmental event in modern human history.

Hopefully, these scenarios will remain fiction, and we will never have to trade these markets or assess the real humanitarian impact.

See you on the margins.✖️5

Ronin's 2026 Strategy: The Good vs. The Bad ⚖️

I analyzed the new "On Ronin" strategy document. Here is the simple breakdown of the Green Flags and Red Flags inside the plan.

🟢 THE GOOD

1. Massive Inflation Cut 
The plan explicitly targets an 80% reduction in inflation. They are aiming to drop inflation from ~25% down to 5-7%.

2. Smart Spending 
They are moving the $30M budget from paying "Validators" to paying "Builders". This is called "Proof of Distribution"—builders get paid based on actual transaction volume.

3. No "Spray and Pray"
The team promised not to waste money on generic grants, memecoins, or random DeFi trends. They are focusing strictly on Gaming and Payments (Philippines).

🔴 THE BAD

1. Staking Rewards Will Drop
This is the trade-off. To get that low inflation, the document says the reduction comes from "Staking". This means passive APY for holders is likely going down.

2. The "Niche" Risk
By ignoring popular trends like Memecoins and Perp Dexes, the chain is taking a risk. They are betting 100% on utility rather than hype.

The Verdict: We are trading "easy passive income" for a "scarce, valuable token." 

What do you guys think? Is this bullish or not for stakers?

#Ronin #Crypto #Analysis

PAHAYAG NG PAMAHALAANG LUNGSOD NG QUEZON

Ikinalulungkot ng Pamahalaang Lungsod ng Quezon ang naganap na aksidente sa Infanta, Quezon kung saan isang bus na sinasakyan ng mga kabataan mula sa Barangay Bagong Silangan ang naaksidente at tumumba sa Marilaque Road. Ang grupo ay patungo sana sa isang youth leadership camp nang mangyari ang insidente.

Tinitiyak ng lokal na pamahalaan na magkakaroon ng hustisya ang mga nasangkot sa insidenteng ito, sakaling lumabas sa imbestigasyon na may pananagutan o pagkukulang ang ilang panig.

Patuloy na nakikipag-ugnayan ang 
City Legal Department sa mga biktima, kanilang pamilya, mga imbestigador at iba pang kinauukulan, para sa mga susunod na hakbang na legal ng lokal na pamahalaan.

Una rito, kaagad kumilos ang lokal na pamahalaan nang matanggap ang ulat hinggil sa aksidente upang matiyak ang agarang pagbibigay ng tulong at serbisyong medikal sa mga biktima. 

Nakipag-ugnayan din ang Quezon City Government sa lokal na pamahalaan ng Infanta, Quezon sa pangunguna ni Mayor L.A. Ruanto. Mabilis namang rumesponde ang kanilang emergency response teams upang tugunan ang sitwasyon at pangalagaan ang mga nasaktan.

Nagpadala rin ang lungsod ng mga emergency medical teams mula sa Quezon City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (QCDRRMO), katuwang ang Barangay Bagong Silangan, at mga barangay ng Batasan Hills, Holy Spirit, Payatas, at Commonwealth. Nagpaabot din ng tulong ang Philippine Red Cross bilang bahagi ng coordinated response efforts.

Sa kabuuan, 47 na kabataan at ang bus driver ang nasangkot sa aksidente. Apatnapu (40) ang nagtamo ng minor injuries, habang pito (7) ang nagtamo ng seryosong pinsala. Ang ilan sa kanila ay agad na inilipat sa East Avenue Medical Center at Quezon City General Hospital para sa karagdagang gamutan. Lubos naming ikinalulungkot na may isang nasawi sa naturang insidente.

Patuloy na nakikipag-usap ang Pamahalaang Lungsod ng Quezon sa mga pamilya ng mga biktima at sisiguraduhin ang pagbibigay ng nararapat na tulong, at suporta sa kanila sa panahong ito ng pagdadalamhati at pagbangon.

Nagpapasalamat ang Quezon City Government sa agarang tulong at pakikipagtulungan ng Pamahalaang Panlalawigan ng Quezon sa pamumuno ni Governor Helen Tan, Pamahalaang Bayan ng Infanta, Quezon sa pangunguna ni Mayor Ruanto, Philippine National Police (PNP) Infanta Municipal Police Station, Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction Office (MDRRMO) Infanta, Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Infanta Sub-Station, MDRRMO Real Quezon, MDRRMO General Nakar Quezon, MDRRMO Tanay, Rizal, BFP General Nakar, at ng Quezon Provincial Health Network – Claro M. Recto Memorial Hospital, at Office of Rep. Ralph Tulfo.

Makakaasa ang publiko na patuloy na susuportahan at aalalayan ng Pamahalaang Lungsod ng Quezon ang lahat ng biktima at ang kanilang mga pamilya, lalo na sa gastusing medikal.
